metadata.title: Statics Protocol
metadata.description: Statics unifies static multi-asset baskets, position-owned finance, and protocol-owned liquidity with a native dollar.
metadata.socialDescription: Static assets. Static rules. Dynamic markets. Own your position.

navigation.returnLanding: Return to Statics Protocol landing page

overview.label: Overview
overview.title: Your portfolio
overview.description: Everything you hold in one place: your Dollar balance, positions, collateral, and rewards waiting to be claimed.

dollar.label: Dollar
dollar.title: Get Statics Dollar
dollar.description: Deposit ETH to receive Dollar, or convert your Dollar and risk shares back into ETH. You will see the exact amounts before you confirm.

wallet.label: Wallet
wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.description: Check your balances, add funds, send assets, and move money in and out of Statics.

faucet.label: Faucet
faucet.title: Get testnet assets
faucet.description: Claim the fixtures used by Statics or open Robinhood's faucet for more testnet ETH and stock tokens.

portal.label: Add funds
portal.title: Add funds to Statics
portal.description: Bring money in from another network or another token. Swap, bridge, or convert to Statics Dollar.

baskets.label: Baskets
baskets.title: Baskets
baskets.description: Mint or redeem a fixed bundle of assets as one unit. You will see exactly what a basket holds before you mint.

positions.label: Positions
positions.title: Your positions
positions.description: Each position holds your baskets, loans, and Dollar together. Manage collateral, staking, and rewards from here.

loans.label: Loans
loans.title: Your loans
loans.description: Money you have borrowed against locked collateral. Review what you owe, what is locked, and when each loan is due.

rewards.label: Rewards
rewards.title: Your rewards
rewards.description: Stake a position to earn a share of protocol fees. Pick which assets to earn in and claim what you have built up.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.title: Provide liquidity
liquidity.description: Supply assets so other people can trade, and earn a share of the trading fees. Review your pools and what they have earned.

create.label: Launch policy
create.title: Basket launch policy
create.description: Public basket creation is closed during the testnet beta. Review how governed launches work and browse the baskets already available.

activity.label: Activity
activity.title: Your activity
activity.description: Every action from this wallet, from the moment you confirm it to the moment it settles.

tools.label: Tools
tools.title: Approval tools
tools.description: Review and revoke the permissions this wallet has granted to Statics.

baskets.subject: baskets
baskets.launchDescription: Public basket creation is closed during the Robinhood testnet beta. Launches use the same backed basket and canonical-pool flow, but the reviewed transaction is executed through Statics governance.
baskets.noPublicTransaction: No public creation transaction is offered
baskets.existingRemainOpen: Existing baskets remain open to anyone to mint, redeem, trade, and use.
baskets.reviewedParameters: Each new basket launches with reviewed backing and canonical pool parameters.
baskets.canEnableLater: Public launches can be enabled later through the protocol creation fee.
baskets.inspectDescription: Inspect each basket's constituents, status, fees, and canonical liquidity.
baskets.title: Statics baskets
baskets.stale: Basket data is temporarily unavailable. Showing the last received state.
baskets.emptyDescription: A basket is a fixed bundle of assets you can mint or redeem as one unit. New launches are currently steward-controlled.
baskets.notFoundDescription: Basket #{id} is not part of this verified deployment.
baskets.creator: Creator
baskets.metadataUnavailable: Token metadata unavailable; address is authoritative.
baskets.tokenWarning: Underlyings may implement transfer fees, rebasing, unusual approvals, or other nonstandard behavior. Review every token address. Holding {symbol} does not earn basket-specific fees.
baskets.walletMintHelp: The {symbol} remains liquid in your wallet and earns no basket rewards.
baskets.newPositionHelp: Creates a PositionNFT and deposits the minted basket in the same transaction. Account-opening fee: {fee} ETH.
baskets.existingPositionHelp: Mints directly into Position #{id} so it can earn selected rewards.
baskets.enterAmount: Enter an amount for a fresh quote
baskets.mintProtection: Approvals use the displayed caller-side maximums.
baskets.poolInactive: This canonical pool is unavailable for swaps.
baskets.retrySwap: Change the amount or pool to retry.

portal.dollarPrompt: Want to deposit USDG or manage Statics Dollar?
portal.slippageHelp: The most the price may move against you before the trade is cancelled.
portal.highSlippage: A high tolerance can fill at a noticeably worse price.

positions.subject: positions
positions.collateralDescription: These BasketTokens belong to this PositionNFT. The Diamond holds them in custody while they earn basket fees and support loans.
positions.title: Your positions
positions.description: A position holds your collateral, staking, rewards, loans, and liquidity together. Move the position and everything inside it moves with it.
positions.creationFee: Opening a new Position costs {fee} ETH. Reusing one you own is free.
positions.stale: Position data is temporarily unavailable. Showing the last received state.
positions.emptyTitle: You do not have any positions yet
positions.emptyDescription: A position is where your baskets, loans, and Dollar live together. Create an empty one to start, or one will be created for you the first time you deposit.

positionDetail.unresolvedObligations: This position has {count} unresolved loan or module obligations.
positionDetail.transferWarning: Transferring this position transfers every attached collateral, staking, reward, loan, Dollar, and liquidity obligation. This release intentionally does not provide a transfer button.
positionDetail.maturityDescription: Your stake is always withdrawable. New stake and newly selected reward assets start earning once they mature; withdrawals take from stake that is not yet earning first.
positionDetail.customRewardHelp: Contract code and ERC-20 metadata are verified before the opt-in transaction.
positionDetail.historicalWarning: Selecting an asset never grants historical rewards. Pending balances are claimed from the Earn page, where every reward source is shown together.
positionDetail.closeReady: This position has no active protocol legs or unresolved obligations and can be burned.
positionDetail.closeBlocked: Closing is blocked by {legs} active legs and {obligations} unresolved obligations.

rewards.subject: rewards
rewards.basketDescription: A deposited basket earns a share of the trading fees on its assets, paid in those same assets. Each basket is claimed on its own.
rewards.earningNoClaim: Earning in {assets}. Nothing to claim yet.
rewards.noBasketsDescription: Mint a basket with depositing switched on, and it starts earning a share of the trading fees on the assets it holds.
rewards.createAndStakeDescription: Reuse a Position you own, or explicitly open a new one, then choose which fee assets it earns.
rewards.reusePositionHelp: Your newest Position is selected by default. Reusing it has no account-opening fee.
rewards.nothingStakedDescription: Stake a position to start earning a share of protocol fees. You choose which assets to earn in, and you can claim whenever you like.
rewards.liquidityDescription: Each active liquidity position earns its pool fees separately. Review and claim those fees with the position that earned them.

rewardsPicker.question: What do you want to earn?
rewardsPicker.note: You are paid in whichever assets you pick. Each one starts earning about a day after you choose it, and only from that point on — choosing an asset later does not earn you a share of fees collected before then.
rewardsPicker.allEarning: All of your stake is earning.

activity.label: Activity
activity.subject: activity
activity.emptyDescription: Everything you do in Statics shows up here, from the moment you confirm it to the moment it settles.

tools.connectTitle: Connect your wallet to manage approvals
tools.connectDescription: Approval authority belongs to a specific wallet, so Statics must know which account to inspect.
tools.loadingDescription: Statics is waiting for the active wallet before reading approvals.
tools.switchDescription: The Tools page only manages approvals for the verified Statics deployment.
tools.noDeployment: No verified Statics deployment is configured.
tools.label: Account tools
tools.title: App approvals
tools.description: Statics uses maximum approvals so routine deposits, minting, repayment, staking, swaps, and liquidity management do not ask for the same authority repeatedly. Revoke any authority here at any time.
tools.revokeNote: “Revoke all” submits one explicit wallet transaction per active authority. It stops if a transaction is rejected or fails; approvals already confirmed remain revoked.

wallet.movesMore: This moves more than the NFT.
wallet.cannotUndo: {assets} will belong to the recipient. This cannot be undone.
wallet.addNftDescription: Paste an NFT contract address. Statics positions and liquidity positions are listed automatically; anything else has to be added because no network call can list every NFT a wallet holds. ERC-1155 collections also need a token id.

dollar.nothingHereDescription: Mint a basket and it starts earning more of the assets it holds. Or get Statics Dollar and stake it to earn in whichever assets you choose.
dollar.basketRewardDescription: Paid in the assets your baskets hold. Claim it whenever you like.
dollar.quoteVerified: Current input verified. Bounds include 0.50% execution tolerance.
dollar.quoteRefreshing: Refreshing for the current input; submission remains disabled.
dollar.reuseSupplyPositionHelp: Reusing a Position you own avoids the account-opening fee.

faucet.description: Claim the USDG, STATICS, and stock-token fixtures needed to exercise the beta.
faucet.needMore: Need more testnet ETH or stock tokens?
faucet.notRecorded: Faucet deployment has not been recorded yet.
faucet.signInInventory: Sign in to read the Statics faucet inventory.
faucet.switchInventory: Switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet to read the faucet inventory.
faucet.refill: The faucet needs a complete refill before another claim.

account.title: Your account
account.solanaMissing: No Solana wallet yet. One is created the first time you use a Solana route.
account.exportWarning: Exporting reveals recovery material that controls this wallet and every asset it holds. Never share it or paste it into a website, chat, or cloud note.
account.privyUnavailableDescription: Your connected wallet and onchain actions still work. Embedded-wallet account actions may fail until Privy recovers.

walletConnection.title: Choose a wallet
walletConnection.description: External EVM wallets connect directly to Statics and do not require Privy authentication.
walletConnection.privyUnavailableDescription: External wallets remain available. Embedded-wallet and account features may not work.
walletConnection.signInForEmbedded: Sign in for an embedded wallet

landing.eyebrow: The anchor is fixed. The market is not.
landing.heroDescription: Every basket is a fixed bundle, always redeemable for exactly what is inside it. No manager, no rebalancing, no liquidations. Markets move around that anchor — Statics pays the people who hold it steady.
landing.heroVisual: Digital marble statue of Robin Hood
landing.heroAlt: A fragmented digital marble statue of Robin Hood wearing a feathered cap and goatee
landing.basketsDescription: A fixed bundle of 1–16 assets, held as a single token. Redeem it any time for exactly what is inside — the same amounts, forever. No manager, no rebalancing, no discretion.
landing.dollarDescription: A dollar backed by collateral anyone can verify on-chain. Risk shares take losses first, so the dollar stays whole.
landing.ownPositionDescription: Baskets, loans, and dollar series live in one position you can hold, transfer, or sell as a single asset.
landing.noLiquidationsDescription: Debt is denominated in the same assets as the collateral, so a price crash moves both sides together. There is nothing to liquidate.
landing.deepLiquidityDescription: A share of every swap becomes permanent protocol-owned liquidity. Pools get deeper the more they trade, and that depth cannot be withdrawn.
landing.stakeEarnDescription: Stake and opt into up to 64 reward assets. Rewards are swap fees paid in kind — real revenue, not emissions.
landing.tagline: Fixed assets. Fixed rules. Everything else is free to move.
landing.redeemExactly: Redeem for exactly what is inside

position.label: Position
position.plain: Everything you hold in Statics, bundled into one transferable item.

basket.label: Basket
basket.plain: A fixed bundle of assets you can mint or redeem as a single unit.

underlying.label: Underlying
underlying.plain: One of the assets a basket holds. A basket is worth what its underlyings are worth.

dollar.label: Dollar
dollar.plain: Statics' own dollar, backed by assets you deposit.

riskShares.label: Risk shares
riskShares.plain: The variable half of a deposit: it absorbs price moves so the Dollar stays stable.

collateral.label: Collateral
collateral.plain: Assets you lock up to back a Dollar balance or a loan.

loan.label: Loan
loan.plain: Money borrowed against collateral you have locked, repayable on its own schedule.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.plain: Assets you supply so other people can trade, earning you a share of the fees.

liquidityPosition.label: Liquidity position
liquidityPosition.plain: Your individual share of a trading pool.

tradingFees.label: Trading fees
tradingFees.plain: The cut taken on each trade in a pool, shared out to the people who supplied it.

protocolLiquidity.label: Protocol-owned liquidity
protocolLiquidity.plain: Liquidity the protocol holds permanently, rather than any individual person.

priceFeed.label: Price feed
priceFeed.plain: The live price the protocol uses to value your assets.

borrowLimit.label: Borrow limit
borrowLimit.plain: The most that can be borrowed against the collateral backing this profile.

health.label: Health
health.plain: How well covered your position is. Higher is safer.

rewards.label: Rewards
rewards.plain: Fees you have earned and can claim.

staking.label: Staking
staking.plain: Depositing Statics so it earns a share of protocol fees. It stays withdrawable.

earningDelay.label: Earning delay
earningDelay.plain: Newly staked funds start earning a little later. They are never locked up.

openToAnyone.label: Open to anyone
openToAnyone.plain: No approval or gatekeeper. Anyone can do this.
